properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 15 at 8:28PM MDT until September 15 at 9:30PM MDT by NWS Grand Junction CO
properties.description:
FFWGJT

The National Weather Service in Grand Junction has extended the

* Flash Flood Warning for...
West Central Grand County in east central Utah...

* Until 930 PM MDT.

* At 828 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 1 and 1.5 inches of rain
have fallen. The expected rainfall rate is 1 to 3 inches in 1 hour.
Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Mainly rural areas of West Central Grand County, and portions of
I-70 between mile marker 175 and mile marker 190.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

Please report observed flooding to local emergency services or law
enforcement and request they pass this information to the National
Weather Service when you can do so safely.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 15 at 7:09PM MDT until September 15 at 9:00PM MDT by NWS Salt Lake City UT
properties.description:
FFWSLC

The National Weather Service in Salt Lake City has extended the

* Flash Flood Warning for...
South Central Emery County in central Utah...

* Until 900 PM MDT.

* At 709 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated another thunderstorm
producing heavy rain approaching the warned area. As this storm
crosses the area, an additional 0.5 to 1.0 inches of rain is
expected over portions of the San Rafael Swell, including Muddy
Creek, Ramp, Cistern, Ding, Dang, Bell, Little Wildhorse, Crack and
Chute Canyons. This will result in another flood wave moving
through these drainages.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of slot canyons and
normally dry washes.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
The Chute of Muddy Creek, Little Wildhorse Canyon, Ding and Dang
Canyons, Crack and Chute Canyons, as well as portions of Goblin
Valley State Park.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Remain alert for flooding even in locations not receiving rain. Dry
washes, streams, and rivers can become raging killer currents in a
matter of minutes, even from distant rainfall.

Flooding is occurring or is imminent. It is important to know where
you are relative to streams, rivers, or creeks which can become
killers in heavy rains. Campers and hikers should avoid streams or
creeks.

properties.description:
...The National Weather Service in Omaha/Valley has issued a Flood

* WHERE...East Nishnabotna River at Red Oak.

* WHEN...Until late Wednesday night.

feet on 06/15/1980.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 15 at 8:10PM CDT until September 16 at 3:30PM CDT by NWS Des Moines IA
properties.description:
* WHAT...Small stream flooding caused by excessive rainfall
continues.

* WHERE...Adair County in southwestern Iowa...

* WHEN...Until 330 PM CDT Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 807 PM CDT, Emergency management reported numerous closed
roads in the warned area, with water nearing Highway 25 south of
Greenfield. Flooding is already occurring. Between 2 and 4 inches
of rain have fallen.
- An additional 1 inch or more is possible in the warned area
through the overnight hours. Impacted streams include the Middle
River.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Greenfield, Stuart, Adair, Fontanelle, Orient, Bridgewater,
Greenfield Municipal Airport and Nodaway Park.
- This includes Interstate 80 between mile markers 73 and 96.
properties.instruction:

weather.gov/desmoines/water.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 15 at 10:50PM EDT until September 15 at 11:45PM EDT by NWS Detroit/Pontiac MI
properties.description:
At 1050 PM EDT, a severe thunderstorm was located near Clayton, or 7
miles northeast of Morenci, moving east at 30 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage to
roofs, siding, and trees.

This severe storm will be near...
Adrian around 1055 PM EDT.
Blissfield around 1105 PM EDT.
Deerfield around 1115 PM EDT.

Other locations impacted by this severe thunderstorm include Seneca,
Ogden Center, Canandaigua, Ridgeway, Palmyra, Sand Creek, Rome
Center, Jasper, Medina, and Weston.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.
